about_the_game:
Rebuild the spiritual world. Purify biomes. Face the Corruption. Cooperate or fall into chaos.

Animagi is an action-cooperative game where 1–4 players control Animagis — spiritual animals capable of manipulating magic, building mystical structures, and restoring corrupted biomes.
Each match takes place on vibrant floating arenas, where time works against you and corrupted creatures will do everything they can to disrupt the restoration ritual.

Combine magic, construction, and teamwork to survive the rising chaos.

BUILD IN THE MIDST OF CHAOS

Follow magical blueprints to assemble spiritual structures.
Find scattered parts across the map, levitate them, and fit them into place while enemies attempt to destroy everything.

• Mystical structures
• Parts scattered across the biome
• Physical world placement
• Visual build validation

STYLIZED MAGIC COMBAT

Each Animagi mage channels vital energy to restore corrupted biomes. Their magic is an extension of their spiritual form — created to purify, protect, and rebuild.

• Fireball, Magic Shield, Levitation, and more.

COOPERATION UNDER PRESSURE

Every player has a crucial role. If one fails, everyone pays the price.

• Some carry pieces
• Others defend
• Others intercept enemies
• Everyone must act fast

The game rewards coordinated teams — and punishes disorganization with humor and chaos.

DYNAMIC EVENTS

No two matches are the same.

• Magical storms
• Corruption bursts
• Spiritual meteors
• Terrain shifts and distortions

Adapt or be overwhelmed.

PHYSICAL ALCHEMY (NO MENUS)

Mix real ingredients into a magical cauldron on the map.
Reactions play out physically in front of the players — explosions, smoke, colors, hilarious failures.

A SPIRITUALLY VIBRANT WORLD

Arenas are floating biomes inspired by Earth’s vital energy: forests, ruins, mountains, and mystical spaces that react to the actions of the players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Online connection required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Stable Internet connection recommended for multiplayer. Optimized for 1080p 60 FPS.

short_description: Animagi is a magical cooperative game where you build, purify, and defend spiritual biomes while facing chaotic creatures in fast-paced matches full of action and strategy.

English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil*
